title: Christian McCaffrey touchdown gives 49ers 35-10 lead in fourth quarter

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Christian McCaffrey touchdown gives 49ers 35-10 lead in fourth quarter
sources.description: It's just about all but over in Mexico City. 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey capped a 13-play, 98-yard drive with a 6-yard touchdown to give San Francisco a 35-10 lead with 13:26 left in the fourth quarter.
